Fix the hero background video fill issue in split-hero.php.

Context:
The user states: "homepage hero background video still not filling the hero section".
We previously attempted to fix this, but the `<video>` element is still not fully stretching to cover the hero background.

Instructions:
1. Examine `site/snippets/blocks/split-hero.php`.
2. Ensure the `<video>` element has absolute positioning that anchors to all 4 edges (`absolute inset-0`), and forces full width/height (`w-full h-full`), and MUST have `object-fit: cover` (`object-cover`). 
3. Crucially, verify the PARENT wrapper of the video (the one taking up the background layer of the section) has `position: absolute; inset: 0; overflow: hidden;` and that the section itself is `position: relative`.
4. Signal completion using `attempt_completion`.

These instructions supersede any conflicting general instructions. Fix the video fill.
